description: Bonez in Claude Code. PreToolUse: asks before the bonez MCP `memory_save` and `rules_write` tools run; reads pass through. SessionStart: tells the agent how to use Bonez (call memory_recall once, with the repository and the task in one sentence, when the work needs project context), and for session saving: finishes a setup the browser answered after its terminal closed, opens the setup page once on a computer that never set it up, uploads sessions in this workspace whose SessionEnd never fired, and announces this session. PostToolUse: after Read/Edit/Write, the file's System Model ref for the agent and, with saving on, the repository-relative path for live sessions; after system_model_fetch, how to use what it returned. UserPromptSubmit: on a session's first prompt, a reminder to make that memory_recall call now that there is a task; when a prompt names a file path, a reminder to recall that file for the task. The prompt's text is never copied into the reminder. No network call here. SessionEnd: hands the transcript to a background upload. Session saving does nothing until it is turned on (README: Session capture).
